Question: What is the one food that your grandma made better than anyone else?
Answer: Two things immediately come to mind when I think of my grandmother. German chocolate cake (Picture from google) She made this for us at holidays. She always made two of them so we could eat one then, and we would have some to take home with us. I’ve never eaten a German chocolate cake any better than hers. Biscuits and Gravy (picture from google) First she would make homemade cat head biscuits [1] Then made homeade sausage gravy to go on top. I would eat until I couldn’t move. I would go stay weeks at a time with her during the summer, and would fix this for me every single morning if I requested it. Needless to say, I requested it ALOT!
